mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRIPS ( routeId, startDt, tripStatus ) VALUES ( #{routeId}, NOW(6), 'MOVING' )
mapper.select: SELECT t.tripId, t.routeId, t.startDt, t.endDt, t.currentStepId, t.tripStatus, r.userId FROM TRIPS t INNER JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId WHERE t.tripId = #{tripId}

SELECT t.tripId, t.routeId, t.startDt, t.endDt, t.currentStepId, t.tripStatus, r.userId FROM TRIPS t INNER JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId WHERE r.userId = #{userId} AND t.tripStatus = 'MOVING' ORDER BY t.startDt DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TRIPS SET tripStatus = 'ARRIVED', endDt = NOW(6) WHERE tripId = #{tripId} AND tripStatus = 'MOVING'
UPDATE TRIPS t INNER JOIN ROUTES r ON r.routeId = t.routeId SET t.tripStatus = 'CANCELLED', t.endDt = NOW(6) WHERE r.userId = #{userId} AND t.tripStatus = 'MOVING'
